title: In-Memory Assembly Loading via Reflection.Assembly
id: 7bbd5a05-5051-49c6-86ac-924c3c296d6c
status: experimental
description: Detects usage of .NET Reflection.Assembly methods to load assemblies from byte arrays or base64 strings, indicative
  of in-memory execution.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.stealth
- attack.t1620
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_powershell_reflection_assembly_load:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - '[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load('
    - '[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom('
    - '[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('
  selection_base64_indicators:
    CommandLine|re: .*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}){3,}={0,2}.*
  filter_common_net_apps:
    OriginalFileName:
    - powershell.exe
    - pwsh.exe
  condition: (selection_powershell_reflection_assembly_load and selection_base64_indicators) and filter_common_net_apps
falsepositives:
- Legitimate use of reflection in development tools or signed scripts performing dynamic assembly loading.
level: high
